# useMultiComboboxHookUsage - A Labels field built on useMultiCombobox: typing filters the labels, the arrow keys move the active option while focus stays in the field, Enter or a click toggles a label and the list stays open, and selected labels show as removable tokens above the field.
# Components: Card, Item, TextInput, Token

<Card padding={4} width={360}>
  <VStack gap={2}>
    <HStack gap={1}>
      <Token />
    </HStack>
    <TextInput role="combobox" />
    <VStack gap={0} role="listbox">
      <Item density="compact" role="option" />
      <Icon />
    </VStack>
  </VStack>
</Card>
